oracle_mapping.begin_and_epoch: Assert each begin response exact discriminant and error. Retain every successful owner handle in a named map. epoch/factory_epoch_count is the runner count of successful begin responses from the same factory, not a product field.
oracle_mapping.registration_ids_and_generation: Derive final registrations and generation only from OwnerValidity returned by validate(owner) at the fixture-declared observation point; compare ordered registrationIds and generation.
oracle_mapping.operation_errors: For each call step compare the full discriminated result shape; registration errors come from result.error, owner validity errors from result.reason, validateRegistration errors from result.error.
oracle_mapping.tokens: Store the exact token returned from each successful register call as firstRegistrationToken/secondRegistrationToken/lastRegistrationToken. Compare first===second for case 039; pass the captured objects to validateRegistration and compare exact result shapes.
oracle_mapping.identity: Resolve every fixture ref to a live object before API invocation. For root, canvas, and target identity steps use strict reference equality at the runner boundary; never convert ref paths to strings as evidence.

oracle_mapping.authorization_claim: Assert no authorization/authentication/permission property is present in exported result keys or public API shape; this is an API surface boundary only, not a permission test.
oracle_mapping.create_owner_called_and_existing_create_: Do not infer from fixture constants. oracle_mapping.saved_owner_and_cache_restore: Derive from begin response presence/absence and exact error; no separate saved-owner flag may be synthesized.
oracle_mapping.reopen_allowed_and_byte_for_byte_claim: Treat as design-boundary fields: compare false to frozen expected only alongside absence of reopen/serialization/byte-comparison methods in the helper API; do not claim runtime persistence behavior.
